Usengaqedela ukumisa — uhlelo lusebenzisa ikhlawudi/Google kuze kulandwe amamodeli.

I-DHIS2 (District Health Information Software) isetshenziswa yiziMnyango Zezempilo emazweni angaphezu kwe-100 ukubika kwezempilo kuzwelonke. Lokhu kuxhumanisa kuthumela izinkomba zenyanga ezihlanganisiwe zesikhungo sakho esibonelweni se-DHIS2 sikazwelonke.
Imibhalo emgqeni iyacutshungulwa manje. Imodeli yamanothi ihlala ishisa ukuze iqembu liphele ngokushesha.
%1$d emgqeni \u2022 %2$d kulungile%3$s. Ukucubungula kweqembu kulayisha imodeli kanye kuzo zonke iziguli.
Thumela idatha yesikhungo ku-DHIS2 ukubika kwezempilo kuzwelonke. Ukubuka kuqala kubonisa idatha ye-dataValueSets eqondile.
Isikhathi: %1$s \u00B7 Ukuhlangana okungu-%2$d \u00B7 Izinhlobo zokuxilonga ezingu-%3$d
Le datha ibizothunyelwa nge-POST ku-/api/dataValueSets esibonelweni sakho se-DHIS2.
Thepha + ukwengeza ekuxilongeni okuqinisekisiwe kwalokhu kuhlangana.
Akukho ukuxilonga okuqoshiwe — isicelo sidinga okungenani ikhodi eyodwa ye-ICD-10.

I-ChartLite imephu ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuxilonga kwakho kwe-ICD-10 kumakhodi enqubo ye-CPT ajwayeleke kakhulu futhi ibale izimali ngokusebenzisa amazinga ereferensi e-SAMA (South African Medical Association). Ekukhiqizweni, lokhu kuxhumaniswa nohlelo lwezimali lwesikhimu sakho somshwalense wezokwelapha ukuze uthole izinani zokukhokhelwa eqondile.
Lena yidatha ye-X12N v5010A1 ebizothunyelwa kumshwalense wezokwelapha/umkhokheli nge-EDI.

Uma uxhunywe ku-inthanethi, i-ChartLite ingathuthukisa amanothi e-SOAP ngamamodeli olimi lwezokwelapha — ikhiqize ukuxilonga okwehlukene, izizathu zokwelashwa ezisekelwe ngobufakazi, namaphuzu okuthemba amakhodi e-ICD-10.
Le bhandeli ye-FHIR R4 ibizothunyelwa nge-POST endaweni ye-MedicationRequest yekhemisi.

Unokuqopha okusebenzayo. Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukubuyela emuva? Ukuqopha kuzolahlekelwa.
